Deckers Brands UGG HOKA analyst consensus 2027 2028 revenue growth

findings.claim: FY27 營收指引維持 $5.86–5.91B、EPS 指引上調至 $7.35–7.50；管理層預期 HOKA 低雙位數成長、UGG 中個位數成長；Q1 HOKA +7.7%（$703.5M）、UGG +4.9%（$278.0M）
findings.source: Deckers Brands Q1 FY2027 Financial Results (Business Wire)

findings.claim: 管理層長期目標：至 FY2030 年營收高個位數年成長，HOKA 與國際市場成長快於整體；未見供需失衡（缺貨／過剩）的結構性或週期性論述
findings.source: Deckers Q1 FY27 earnings call highlights (Nasdaq/MarketBeat)

findings.claim: Zacks 共識隱含 FY27 EPS 成長 6.1%、FY28 成長 10.6%（Q1 前資料，可能過時）；未找到 FY28 營收共識數字
findings.source: Chartmill: Can UGG & HOKA's Global Growth Drive Deckers' Next Phase?
findings.excerpt: The Zacks Consensus Estimate for Deckers' fiscal 2027 earnings implies year-over-year growth of 6.1%, whereas the same for fiscal 2028 indicates an uptick of 10.6%.

findings.claim: 關稅假設由 10% 上調至 12.5%，管理層預期 Q2 毛利率受關稅與運費壓力；風險列有消費支出轉變、貿易政策、供應鏈中斷
findings.source: Deckers Q1 FY27 earnings call highlights (MarketBeat)

supply_demand_durability.note: 搜尋兩次，未找到供需缺貨/過剩的結構 vs 週期論述（品牌型消費品），多數來源為摘要無逐字原文。
